items.title: FIBA U17 World Cup Recap
items.body_excerpt: The 2026 FIBA U17 World Cup went about how it almost always does. Team USA cruised to a gold medal behind a 7-0 record and massive point differential to extend the program’s all-time record to 58-0 and its eighth straight gold medal. Joaquim Boumtje Boumtje walked away with MVP…
